text.description_html:
Acorn APBBP, Smooth Iron Spear Cabinet Pull

Acorn's Smooth Iron Spear Tip Cabinet Pull is great for light interior doors, cabinet doors, and drawers. It can easily be mounted vertically or horizontal and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. The spear tip cabinet drawer pull has a smooth iron finish.

Smooth Iron surface hardware is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

Features and Specifications of the Acorn APBBP Spear Tip Collection Cabinet Door Pull:

  • Length (center to center): 3-9/16"
  • Overall Length: 5-1/8"
  • Mount Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Package includes 1 cabinet pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.

    • Sold Individually
